title: Walkway showing HKU Station sign and temporary screening table
objects_and_counts: One large overhead station sign reading both Chinese and English suspended centrally above the walkway.
One partially visible person cropped at the far left edge of the image (only torso/arm visible).
Two small rectangular folding tables with wooden tops and black metal tripod legs: one at left foreground and one at right foreground next to a sign stand.
One freestanding sign/notice mounted on a metal post at the right foreground, positioned on the right-hand table.

Multiple vertical steel/metal columns supporting the canopy along both sides of the walkway; at least 11 full columns are visible on the left side and at least 6 on the right side within the image frame (some columns are cropped at image edges).

Multiple waist-high metal balustrades/panels lining both sides of the walkway (a continuous run, many repeated panels visible; exact total cannot be determined because panels continue outside the frame).
One raised tactile guidance strip running down the centre of the walkway floor.
One high-rise building façade visible through the right side windows with repeated blue-tinted panels and external cross-braces.
Multiple overhead ceiling panels and linear recessed lights along the walkway ceiling.
visible_text: Temperature Screening Machine Testing in Progress
spatial_relations: The large bilingual station sign hangs centrally from the ceiling above the walkway, roughly mid-image horizontally and nearer the far end of the corridor than the foreground.
The walkway runs from the foreground toward a darker exit or gate area at the far center of the image; the tactile guidance strip runs down the middle of the floor aligning with this direction.
Vertical columns are arranged in two parallel lines along the left and right sides of the walkway; glass panels and balustrades sit between these columns and the external windows.
The two small folding tables are placed near the front of the image: one at the left edge and one at the right edge; the right table is adjacent to the freestanding sign on a post.
The blue-tinted external building façade is visible through the windows on the right side of the walkway and is outside the balustrade line.
colours_and_materials: Ceiling panels are pale beige or off-white with recessed linear light fittings.
Vertical columns and balustrade frames are painted or finished in a muted teal/gray metal colour.
Balustrade panels appear to be frosted or translucent glass with metal top rails.
Tables have light to medium brown wooden tops with black metal legs.
External building façade visible at right is blue-tinted glass with pale blue structural star-shaped connectors.
uncertainties: Some small overhead signs near the far exit contain Chinese characters and symbols; only '列車' is clearly legible, other characters on those signs are not fully readable from this resolution.
The central pillar-mounted sign in the distance shows 'FB' and 'C' but accompanying smaller text is unreadable.

The freestanding notice's lower lines include small Chinese text that are not legible; I transcribed the top English line as 'Temperature Screening Machine Testing in Progress' but portions of the sign may be misread or incomplete.
Exact counts of repeated balustrade panels and columns cannot be determined because the structure continues beyond the image edges and some elements are cropped.
The person at the left edge is cropped and not identifiable; only part of their torso/arm is visible.

Some repeated 'HKU' markings on the right-hand strap/railing are shown multiple times; I listed 'HKU' repeated entries but did not attempt to infer total strap length or full repeated count beyond visible instances.
